answer: Orchid society membership with show bloom records is the check: blooms shown under one society across seasons. A farm faking 430 aliases needs 430 separate bloom records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The umber check runs in the open: 430 fakes pay the full price 430 times, one honest agent pays once, and the sable trail in the ledger makes the vine cost visible to everyone.
